weaknesses.title: Late LET bag + SYS PUSH after FINDOBJ under -s → unknown form
weaknesses.detail: Footer LET rpt=...; SYS PUSH rpt run_date failed only on gate path (after FINDOBJ) under -s with err unknown form 'rpt'. Same PUSH works earlier (meta) and without -s. Predeclaring fleet_rep before actions works around. Parser/runtime hazard for agents building bags late.
weaknesses.repro: FINDOBJ then near EOF LET rpt; SYS PUSH rpt x under -s

weaknesses.title: WHEREOBJ/FINDOBJ equality only — no lag>N range query
weaknesses.detail: Cannot select replicas with lag greater than threshold. Agents need exact lag values or EACH+IF. find_lag 15 misses 10/20/30 fleet.

weaknesses.title: SETFALL has no WHERE filter — stamps entire class
weaknesses.detail: Drain stamp sets mode=drain on primary too. No SETFALL Replica mode drain WHERE role replica. Agents must EACH or per-slot SETF.
weaknesses.repro: stamp drain → WHEREOBJ drain includes primary r0

weaknesses.title: WHEREOBJ returns name bag but SEND/SETF on bag names needs EACH or LAST
weaknesses.detail: Cannot SEND names_bag use. FINDOBJ LAST works for GETF LAST; full bag needs EACH LINE + dynamic name (awkward).
weaknesses.repro: WHEREOBJ mode drain; cannot bulk SEND bag

weaknesses.title: Process-local objects force DUMPOBJ plate rehydrate every ARG run
weaknesses.detail: Multi-action host scripts dump after every mutation. No native object plate persistence.
weaknesses.repro: open then separate process harvest without dump → empty

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN path-only — harvest label uses REPLACEALL template
weaknesses.detail: n:N sum:S avg:A via REPLACEALL not JOIN.
